_about: WIELDER event hooks (wielder/hooks.py). Each hook binds an event name to a queue card template; title/description may reference payload keys as {key}. Events arrive via the data/hooks-inbox/ drop door or `wielder hooks fire`. Empty by default — hooks are added by the manager as real events are named.

hooks.description: Target {target_id}. Missing evidence: {missing}. The run is parked: a verifier pass without attached, hash-bound evidence is a FAIL at the proof gate (wielder/evidence.py). Attach the evidence or rule on the run.
hooks.title: PROOF GATE: run {run_id} — verifier pass without evidence

hooks.description: Target {target_id}. Drift: {drift}. The run is parked and landing is blocked until the drift is resolved or the owner rules on it (wielder drift-waive --card <id> --fingerprint <fp> --ruling '...').
hooks.title: INSTRUCTION DRIFT: run {run_id} — out-of-scope work blocked

hooks.description: Loop evidence: {loop}. The run parked itself rather than loop silently (wielder/circles.py). Rule on the run or fix the plan; the journal keeps every completed step, so a resume repeats nothing.
hooks.title: CIRCLE DETECTOR: run {run_id} parked itself — loop detected

hooks.description: The stall watch parked this run after {stale_checks} heartbeat checks with no progress (wielder/circles.py). It is presumed dead or stalled mid-job; wielder resume-run can pick it up from the park — completed steps are in its journal.
hooks.title: STALL WATCH: run {run_id} parked — no progress across heartbeat checks
